access_pathway_details.text: Seven FDA-approved CAR-T products are listed by FDA: Abecma, Aucatzyl, Breyanzi, Carvykti, Kymriah, Tecartus and Yescarta. In June 2025 FDA eliminated the REMS for approved BCMA- and CD19-directed autologous CAR-T products.

eligibility_requirements.text: Diagnosis and prior therapy must match the FDA-approved indication of the specific product.

provider_requirements.text: Since the June 2025 REMS elimination, hospitals and clinics no longer must be specially certified or have on-site, immediate access to tocilizumab under a REMS.

risk_notes.text: Labeling includes a boxed warning for cytokine release syndrome and neurological toxicities.

oversight_notes.text: Boxed warning, adverse-event reporting, and required post-marketing studies with 15-year patient follow-up.

arbitrage_summary.text: US: seven FDA-approved CAR-T products for hematologic malignancies; REMS centre certification removed in 2025.
